chip.description: LANC: the link/LAN interface controller of networked Konami cabinets, driving an RS485 transceiver over 64 KB of shared RAM (taxonomy §4.10 example).
chip.notes: src/devices/machine/k056230.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Konami IC 056230 (LANC)"), device full name "Konami 056230 LANC"; the surrounding circuit is 64k shared RAM, an LS161 counter, a 056787 PAL and an HYC2485S RS485 transceiver. Classification also fixed by docs/taxonomy.md §4.10, which names "Konami 056230 (link/LAN)" as an io example. MAME's separate k056230_viper device is deliberately NOT mapped to this chip: the same source records the TODO "LANC part name for konami/viper.cpp", so the Viper part number is unestablished.
